column2: Use the creature's power as it last existed on the battlefield
column3: Misattached in Scryfall data: the official CLB release notes (Jess Dunks, 2022-06-01) list this ruling under Astarion's Thirst ("where X is the power of the creature exiled this way"), which has no rulings of its own; Astarion, the Decadent has no X and nothing based on power, so there is no behavior to test on this card (for Astarion's Thirst it is CR 608.2h last known information)
